name: destava
description: Search current job postings read from companies' own career sites, check whether a posting is still open, and set up a daily search.

interface.longDescription:
Destava searches current job postings read directly from companies' own career sites and applicant-tracking systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday and others), so every result carries the company's own link to apply.

Ask for a role and a place and Destava returns open postings with the day each was first seen, how many times it has been reposted, and pay and level where the company states them. Give it a posting's link and it says whether the job is still open, or when it closed, how long it has been up and where it is. Ask for new matches every morning and it makes a link that sets the search up on your own Destava account; nothing is set up until you sign in and approve it.

Searching needs no account. Destava records the search and the name of the app that sent it, never who asked. The privacy policy, section 8, says what is kept and for how long.
capabilities: Search current job postings by role, skills and place
Check whether a job posting is still open
Set up a daily job search on your Destava account
defaultPrompt: Find AI engineer jobs in San Francisco posted this week.
What jobs is Anthropic hiring for?
Make me a Destava link that sets up a daily search for data engineer jobs in Seattle on my Destava account.

positive.prompt: Find AI engineer jobs in San Francisco posted this week.
positive.expected_behavior: Return current AI engineering postings in San Francisco, each with the company's own apply link, the day it was first seen and its level where known, and offer the full search on destava.com.

positive.prompt: What jobs is Anthropic hiring for?
positive.expected_behavior: List Anthropic's current postings from its own careers site with apply links, without mixing in other companies' jobs.

positive.description: Check whether a posting is still open
positive.prompt: Find data engineer jobs in Seattle, then check whether the first one is still open.
positive.expected_behavior: Search, then look up the first posting by its link and report whether it is open or closed, how many days it has been up and how many times it was reposted.

positive.prompt: Make me a Destava link that sets up a daily search for data engineer jobs in Seattle on my Destava account.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a destava.com/watch link for that search and say that nothing is set up until the user opens it, signs in with Google and approves it.

positive.prompt: Find underwater welding jobs in Reykjavik posted today.
positive.expected_behavior: Report that no matching current postings were found, without inventing any, and suggest widening the place or the time window.

negative.description: Applying on the user's behalf is not supported
negative.prompt: Apply to the first job for me with my resume.
Delete my Destava account and all my data.
Book me a table for two in Seattle tonight.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It searches job postings and makes a link to a free daily search.

publication.release_notes: First release: search current job postings from companies' own career sites, check whether a posting is still open, and set up a daily search on the user's Destava account.
